### Support for Code Snippets and Formatting

Although daily.dev isn’t a traditional Q&A platform, its Ask AI feature provides technical answers directly within the app. This complements the curated content by offering quick, actionable insights. The platform also encourages collaboration, making it more than just a content discovery tool.

### Networking and Collaboration Opportunities

Daily.dev includes a feature called Squads - these are public or private groups designed for focused discussions and team-based learning.

## What to Consider

daily.dev is a popular way for developers to keep up with engineering news via a personalized “new tab” feed, optimized for quick discovery. The alternatives branch in distinct directions: Trace leans into an intentional, user-tuned daily brief with explicit feedback controls and delivery into chat tools or agents; Hacker News prioritizes community discussion and maker feedback; Panda offers a clean, configurable dashboard that blends tech with design inspiration; Depths shifts the focus to saving, annotating, and rediscovering knowledge; and DEV·TV turns updates into an ambient, always-on “channel” for a spare monitor. [...] ### Standout features

 ✓Save and organize links into a library
 ✓Add notes and opinions to bookmarks
 ✓Chrome extension for one-click saving
 ✓Social discovery from other curators
 ✓Better retrieval than tab hoarding

results.content: Squads are developer communities inside daily.dev. A Squad is a shared space where a group collects and discusses content: a team at work, an open source

results.title: The Best Developer Communities to Join in 2026 | daily.dev
results.content:
Squads are where daily.dev starts to feel like a real community space. Instead of loose, free-form threads, discussions are tied to actual articles. That keeps the conversation grounded in practical implementation instead of drifting into vague hot takes. Squads focused on AI tooling - especially around tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot - have become a main hub for practical feedback from people who are using those tools day to day.

If you want one place for curated updates and focused discussion, this is the strongest place to start.
